title: Mixture of experts architectures for machine learning interatomic potentials
abstract: arXiv:2603.07977v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials (MLIPs) enable accurate large-scale atomistic simulations, yet improving their expressive capacity efficiently remains challenging. Here we systematically investigate Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) and Mixture-of-Linear-Experts (MoLE) architectures within the DPA3 framework for MLIPs and analyze the effects of routing strategies and expert designs. We show that sparse activation combined with shared experts yields substantial performance gains, and that nonlinear MoE formulations outperform MoLE when shared experts are present, underscoring the importance of nonlinear expert specialization. Furthermore, element-wise routing consistently surpasses configuration-level routing, while global MoE routing often leads to numerical instability. translated_title: 混合专家架构在机器学习原子间势中的应用
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2603.07977v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）能够实现精确的大规模原子模拟，但高效提升其表达能力仍具挑战。我们系统地研究了DPA3框架内用于MLIPs的混合专家（MoE）和混合线性专家（MoLE）架构，并分析了路由策略和专家设计的影响。我们表明，稀疏激活结合共享专家能带来显著的性能提升，且在存在共享专家时，非线性MoE公式优于MoLE，强调了非线性专家专门化的重要性。此外，逐元素路由始终优于配置级路由，而全局MoE路由常导致数值不稳定性。由此产生的逐元素MoE模型在OMol25、OMat24和OC20M基准上始终优于所有基于DPA3的基线模型。路由模式的分析...
tldr: 本文在DPA3框架中系统探索了混合专家架构，发现逐元素路由与非线性共享专家结合能显著提升机器学习原子间势的性能，并在多个基准上超越现有基线。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically explores Mixture-of-Experts architectures in the DPA3 framework, finding that element-wise routing with nonlinear shared experts substantially boosts machine learning interatomic potential performance, surpassing existing baselines across multiple benchmarks.
